summary: Iteration 4 testing of the new Super Draw feature, NPL1 rename and amber Time column, plus regression of main-board admin editing. Backend: 68 pytest tests executed (new test_superdraw.py 20/20, test_superdraw_db.py 2/3, test_superdraw_reveal_unit.py 6/6, plus pre-existing suites) -> 67 passed / 1 failed (missing unique index, hardening only). Frontend: verified '/' shows NPL1 headline, Time header+cells amber rgb(217,119,6), 'Super Draw' nav works; '/super-draw' loads without auth, shows number 58/77 with 11:30 AM reveal text, past-date picker + Main Board link work; admin Super Draw editor validates and saves with toast, public page reflects the new number; per-slot Save regression still persists to the correct slot only.

minor.issue: No unique index on 'date' (boards.date likewise). ensure_super_draw relies on find-then-insert, so concurrent first-hits of the day can create two documents for the same date (the insert-race except branch can never trigger without the unique index). Add await db.super_draws.create_index('date', unique=True) in startup.
No brute-force lockout/rate limiting: 7 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 and a valid login immediately succeeds (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails).

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid combination per the CORS spec; auth is Bearer-token in localStorage rather than httpOnly cookies (deviation from auth playbook, though functionally working). bcrypt hash format verified OK ($2b$12$, 60 chars); seed_admin correctly re-hashes when the env password changes.
Accepts an arbitrary past 'date' and silently updates historical results (404 only when the date has no doc). Consider restricting edits to today or logging an audit trail.

issues: Latest-draw row overrides the new amber with dark navy (.row-latest .ss-col-time { color:#0f172a }) so 1 of 63 Time cells is not amber - confirm this is intentional.
Pending rows use pale amber #e5b881 on white (rgb(229,184,129)), contrast ratio ~1.9:1 - fails WCAG AA; darken (e.g. #b45309 at reduced opacity) for readability.

design_issues.screen: Home / Super Draw / Admin date pickers
issues: All date inputs use the browser-native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy widget) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component, which looks inconsistent with the rest of the styled UI.

action_items: Add unique index on super_draws.date (and boards.date) at startup to guarantee one document per day under concurrency.
Decide/fix Time-column color exceptions: latest row dark navy override and low-contrast pale amber for pending rows.
Optional hardening: login rate-limit/lockout, explicit CORS origins instead of '*' with allow_credentials, restrict PUT /api/superdraw to today's date.
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_super_draw / ensure_board use a find-then-insert pattern whose race-handling except branch is dead code without a unique index on 'date'.

build_super_response reveal gate verified by unit test with an injected clock: masked (number=null, revealed=false) before 11:30 AM IST, unmasked at/after 11:30; admin_view and past dates always revealed - logic is correct.
server.py is ~486 lines and already mixes auth, board and super-draw concerns; consider splitting into routers before it grows past 700 lines.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found. The single failing test is an intentional hardening assertion: super_draws has no unique index on 'date', so the documented 'exactly one document per date' guarantee depends on request timing rather than a DB constraint.
